tasks.title: Target customer profile
tasks.description: Who has the problem, who pays, who decides (may differ in healthcare). Demographics/firmographics, current behavior, triggers. Output: research/customer-profile.md

tasks.title: Competitor map
tasks.description: Direct, indirect, substitutes. Name, URL, offering, pricing if public, funding if public, positioning, gaps. Output: research/competitor-map.md

tasks.title: Market size estimate with sources
tasks.description: TAM/SAM/SOM, bottom-up preferred. Every number sourced; show the math. Output: research/market-size.md

tasks.title: Pricing benchmarks
tasks.description: What comparable products charge and how (subscription, per-test, per-seat, reimbursement codes). Propose a pricing hypothesis. Output: research/pricing.md

tasks.title: Where target customers talk online
tasks.description: Communities, forums, subreddits, patient groups, professional networks, conferences — with URLs and rough size/activity. Read only; no posting. Output: research/channels.md

tasks.title: 10 interview questions (Mom Test style)
tasks.description: Questions about past behavior and real spending, not opinions or hypotheticals. No pitching. Include who to interview and how to recruit (CEO executes). Output: research/interview-guide.md

tasks.title: Riskiest assumptions list
tasks.description: Rank assumptions by risk x uncertainty. Top 3 each with: test method, cost/time, kill criterion. Output: research/riskiest-assumptions.md

tasks.title: Critic review of all Phase 1 research
tasks.description: Review each file in research/ against its sources. Output: research/reviews/
